question: On four fixed known-answer ideals, do msolve basis and parametrization outputs preserve the distinction between distinct solution support and quotient-algebra dimension?

claims.text: The actual bivariate quotient has dimension two for every c; c=0 has a unique solution. This theorem is decided only by Lean, independently of solver output.
On each of the four fixtures the returned basis matches the fixed certificate and the parameter qdim/degree equal registered quotient/support counts.
General Diem Bezout, minimal solver degree, asymptotic behavior, C-to-F4Run refinement and independent-host validation are outside this fixture decision.

arms.description: Default finite-field parametrization; read qdim separately from eliminant degree

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact algebraic invariants, no sampling noise or timing claim; each fixed call repeats twice as a consistency check, not an A/A variance estimate.

positive.not_applicable_reason: All fixtures are known-answer controls. Before freeze the c=2 calibration detected a wrong constant and rejected a zero basis element. No statistical detector claim.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No population or random-null inference; exact solution count/ideal certificates replace a statistical null.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Same binary/dependencies/one thread/exact sparse linear algebra on both modes.

factors.name: host
factors.how: provenance.json; no clock accepted as evidence.

factors.name: mode
factors.how: Every fixture in both modes, two repetitions.

factors.name: internal_randomness
factors.value: srand(time(0)) when genericity uses random linear form
factors.how: CLI has no seed option; capture containing start/end epoch interval and full parameter output. Exact verified invariants only.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen native analysis and expected values before affected data.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: No paid cloud; every outcome retained; no outcome-dependent retry.

comparisons.threshold: Every fixture basis/certificate, input reductions, S-pairs, staircase, qdim, eliminant degree, points and exit status must match the registered expected values; zero discrepancies.

seed_derivation.note: Upstream msolve.c:718 seeds libc rand with time(0) if a random form is needed. No external seeding is supported. Run.sh records start/end epoch seconds containing this internal seed. No random-support distribution claim.

instance_sampling.rule: Four explicitly listed fixed fixtures, fully crossed across both modes; not sampled from a population.

blinding.how: Exact known-answer validation; expected identities known before solver data.

power.note: No sampling test or confidence interval; all sixteen fixed calls included. Alpha is schema metadata and carries no inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Held-out c=2: GB0.012s,param0.217s, two variables degree<=2 like registered class; unisolated budget estimate only. 16*0.217=3.472s, rounded up to10s excluding completed builds/proofs.

primary.name: Exact GB certificate
primary.definition: Normalized basis equals frozen expected basis, S-pairs and input reductions vanish.

primary.name: Quotient dimension
primary.definition: Finite standard-monomial staircase and printed qdim equal2/2/1/1.

primary.name: Distinct solution support
primary.definition: Exhaustive base-field point count and eliminant degree equal1/2/1/1 on these split known-answer systems.

secondary.name: Exploratory selected-pair degree
secondary.definition: Maximum parsed degree from GB-mode verbose round lines;0 if no round. Does not certify minimal solving degree.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly four fixtures times two modes times two repetitions. Retain every outcome and stop after these16calls.
Each call terminates after30seconds; timeout is retained and never rerun based on outcome.

invalidation_rules: Missing/malformed output or nonzero exit means fixture not validated; preserve data and report the diagnostic.
No after-data parser patch under this protocol; any correction requires a new labelled version preserving originals.

decision_rule.text: Report exact fixture_pass only when every registered check passes in both repetitions; otherwise report discrepancy or not_validated, never silently discard a call.
decision_rule.statistic: exact integer equality and polynomial reductions
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: integer discrepancy from registered known answer; no sampling inference

inadmissible: Calling c=2 preflight out-of-sample or confirmatory.
Suppressing failed outputs or regenerating the frozen analysis after seeing affected data.
Treating point support as scheme length or pair-degree logs as minimal solving-degree proofs.
Claiming statistical, timing, generic F4 conformance, independent-host or signed validation from these fixtures.

literature.claim: General bound scope/multiplicities and incomplete F4 refinement; fixture is a control only.
CLI/output schema prints quotient dimension and univariate degree separately; genericity may reorder/add a variable.
Actual quotient-algebra equivalence and support counterexample checked by Lean; no new axioms.

extensions.preflight_scope: c=2 only, in-sample calibration; affected c=0,c=1,simple,degree3 outputs unseen
extensions.checkpoint_exception: User approved local checkpoints for this audit; bounded independent call files; zero paid spend.
